completeness.why: getNextDate passes its skipWeekend/weekendSolve to getDateWithWeekendRule and keeps only its own noSkipWeekend guard (a variation no other site has), and getUpcomingDates passes its config fields directly; both schedule-template sites call the new function but keep their outer `dateConditions.value.skipWeekend ? ... : nextBaseDate` ternary, so whether the rule applies is still decided there (twice).

interface.why: getDateWithWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) takes exactly the real variation (enable flag and mode) with no speculative options, and each caller maps its own field name; the noSkipWeekend override stays explicit at its one site.

disguised_duplication.where: no logic reshaped; the leftover enable check in schedule-template.ts is an unremoved copy, not a disguised one
